data.title: bn-sqr3: deliver owner-cohort fix via product test overlay; revert trunk engine change
data.description: Children are built from the archive of pinned commit d644dc58, not trunk, so the bn-2304 trunk fix never reached them; the cohort gate is cfg(test)-only so the measured A/B/C/D binaries are unaffected and the variant-A pin must not move. Reverts bn-2304/bn-1gtb/bn-3hlo (restoring trunk engine.rs == pinned engine.rs) and re-delivers the fix as five 1:1 overlay hunks (retained admission count across the one-shot disarm; assert reads it; poison-tolerant disarm) plus 7 allowlist entries and 3 patch-hash pins. Seal audit records for the reverted reviews (cr-1gpsj3, cr-2u8n2e, cr-3podjz) deliberately preserved. Verified: validator PASS 11 checks, SELF_TEST_PASS 17 mutations, git apply --check clean, cargo check --tests clean, full mess-store suite 30 suites/0 failed with the patched engine, preflight green. Commit b46fb01.
